Title: The Anesheym of Rhemhex'Qen
Description:
This mod is currently in beta form. It is not finished. And will be releasing new content in phases throughout its development along with fixing any bugs, typos or relevant info over time. Thank you for your patience!

Credits
Credit to Sol for their work on composing the suite that accompanies the Grand Shah called "Progenitor."
Credit to Ontoclasm for their work on the tiles for the games.
Credit to the The Sibs for their work on the library expansion.


This mod adds a new region to the map known as Bevidd, along with a new race of insecto-humanoid beings known as the anesheym. This mod will feature new quests, like an egg-hunt, diving into the depths of an old eater's gene-splicing facility and much more. A new companion, a popular Kung-Fu bug-lady known as Arshira (She hangs out in Lulihart's tent) and several new entities and factions to immerse yourself in. Discover the secrets of this ancient race and add some new flavor to the Qud World Map.

This mod requires:

Qud-Fu - Mixed Martial Arts in Caves of Qud
Brothers’ Modding Library


This mod is for open development in the Caves of Qud Discord Server. Comments and Discussions are currently disabled on steam.Quick thank you to, Armithaig, Gnarf, AricIronhand,Balthichou, Underdog, Sol, Ontoclasm, Bingles and many others for the info, help and inspo to take on this project.
